pages.text: Use an empty main hand on eligible grasses, reeds, nettle or vines to collect a raw bundle. Place it on suitable stone.
Left-click all 64 cells, by hand or with a stone scraper. Scraper clears a cross. Sneak-left retrieves unfinished work; after completion click again for four dry fibers.
Spindle: two fibers in offhand, spindle in main hand, right-click for four threads. Loom: load three threads, wait five seconds, collect two woven fibers. JEI/Core Recipes shows actual processes.
